import duckdb
con = duckdb.connect('playbook.duckdb', read_only=True)
q = '''
WITH sessions AS (SELECT * FROM sessions),
customer_conversions AS (SELECT * FROM customer_conversions),
ad_spend AS (SELECT * FROM ad_spend),
sessions_before_conversion AS (
    SELECT sessions.*, customer_conversions.converted_at, customer_conversions.revenue,
        count(*) over (partition by sessions.customer_id) as total_sessions,
        row_number() over (partition by sessions.customer_id order by sessions.started_at) as session_index
    FROM sessions
    LEFT JOIN customer_conversions ON sessions.customer_id = customer_conversions.customer_id
    WHERE sessions.started_at <= customer_conversions.converted_at
        AND sessions.started_at >= customer_conversions.converted_at - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
with_points AS (
    SELECT *, 1.0 / total_sessions as linear_points, revenue * (1.0 / total_sessions) as linear_revenue
    FROM sessions_before_conversion
)
SELECT w.utm_source,
       ROUND(SUM(w.linear_points),4) as points,
       ROUND(SUM(w.linear_revenue),4) as revenue,
       COALESCE(SUM(a.spend),0) as spend
FROM with_points w
LEFT JOIN ad_spend a ON w.utm_source=a.utm_source AND w.utm_medium=a.utm_medium AND w.utm_campaign=a.utm_campaign
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
'''
print(con.execute(q).fetchdf().to_string())
"
